raw_ocr_text: NOTE: The original LLM extraction incorrectly extracted a 5-call rectangular description from the deed body, which stated 'BEGINNING at a point in the southwesterly line of Pennbrook Drive 145 feet southwesterly from the southwestern side of Concord Place; thence (1) South 53° 50' 56" West a distance of 125 feet to a corner; thence (2) South 36° 09' 04" East a distance of 142 feet to a corner; thence (3) North 53° 50' 56" East a distance of 125 feet to a point in a line of Pennbrook Drive; thence (4) North 36° 09' 04" West along and along the southwesterly line of Pennbrook Drive 142 feet to the place of BEGINNING.' However, the deed clearly states 'SEE EXHIBIT "A" ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF' in the Property section. The correct legal description is in Exhibit A (pages 5/6 of the deed), which describes a 7-call L-shaped lot. This ground truth now reflects the correct Exhibit A description.
